brief:
Israel killed more than 1,480 Palestinians in the year following a ceasefire agreement, according to Zeteo's weekly roundup of developments in occupied Gaza and the West Bank. The deaths occurred amid what the outlet describes as Israel's continuation of military operations and what it characterizes as genocidal war policies in the territory.

The report compiles incidents across Gaza and the West Bank during the period, documenting casualties that Zeteo says have continued despite the ceasefire arrangement. The outlet's weekly coverage tracks ongoing violence and settlement policies it frames as part of an apartheid system.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israel killed over 1,480 Palestinians in year since ceasefire, Zeteo reports
